get.summary: List secret scanning alerts for an organization

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: state
params.desc: Set to `open` or `resolved` to only list secret scanning alerts in a specific state.

params.name: sort
params.desc: The property to sort the results by. `created` means when the alert was created. `updated` means when the alert was updated or resolved.

params.name: direction
params.desc: The direction to sort the results by.

params.name: is_publicly_leaked
params.desc: A boolean value representing whether or not to filter alerts by the publicly-leaked tag being present.

params.name: is_multi_repo
params.desc: A boolean value representing whether or not to filter alerts by the multi-repo tag being present.

params.name: hide_secret
params.desc: A boolean value representing whether or not to hide literal secrets in the results.

get.desc:
Lists the secret scanning pattern configurations for an organization.

Personal access tokens (classic) need the `read:org` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

patch.desc:
Updates the secret scanning pattern configurations for an organization.

Personal access tokens (classic) need the `write:org` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

pattern_config_version.description: The version of the entity. This is used to confirm you're updating the current version of the entity and mitigate unintentionally overriding someone else's update.

token_type.description: The ID of the pattern to configure.

push_protection_setting.description: Push protection setting to set for the pattern.

token_type.description: The ID of the pattern to configure.

custom_pattern_version.description: The version of the entity. This is used to confirm you're updating the current version of the entity and mitigate unintentionally overriding someone else's update.

push_protection_setting.description: Push protection setting to set for the pattern.

state.description: Sets the state of the secret scanning alert. You must provide `resolution` when you set the state to `resolved`.

resolution.description: **Required when the `state` is `resolved`.** The reason for resolving the alert.

resolution_comment.description: An optional comment when closing or reopening an alert. Cannot be updated or deleted.

assignee.description: The username of the user to assign to the alert. Set to `null` to unassign the alert.

params.desc: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.desc: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

post.desc:
Creates a bypass for a previously push protected secret.

The authenticated user must be the original author of the committed secret.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: owner
params.desc: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.desc: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

reason.description: The reason for bypassing push protection.

placeholder_id.description: The ID of the push protection bypass placeholder. This value is returned on any push protected routes.
